characters.name: Elena Volkova
characters.description: A 34-year-old astrophysicist, determined and brilliant but haunted by a failed experiment that cost her team their lives.
characters.voice: calm, measured, with a slight tremor when emotional
characters.appearance: shoulder-length dark hair often tied back, pale complexion, dark circles under eyes, usually wears a lab coat or simple sweater

characters.name: Dr. Ivan Kovac
characters.description: Director of the Institute, charismatic and ruthless. He knows more about the failed experiment than he admits.
characters.voice: deep, smooth, authoritative with a hint of condescension
characters.appearance: tall, silver-gray hair, perfectly tailored suits, cold blue eyes

characters.name: Maya Rivera
characters.description: Elena's younger sister, a journalist who is trying to help uncover the truth. Optimistic and brave.
characters.voice: warm, energetic, speaks quickly when excited
characters.appearance: curly brown hair, freckles, always carries a notebook, casual clothing
